findings.summary: Off-by-one in the Intervals.icu page cap: the comment says "max 24 pages" but the guard allows a 25th.
findings.mechanism: page starts at 1 (per the `payload.page === 1` init check and `(payload.page - 1) * ACTIVITIES_PER_PAGE` math). The guard `payload.page <= MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES` (24) still queues a next page when payload.page === 24 (24 <= 24 is true), producing page 25. So the loop actually processes 25 pages, one more than MAX_INTERVALS_PAGES and one more than the comment's stated ~4-year bound implies.
